name: Denmark
description: Denmark from the Vikings and Harald Bluetooth to the Kalmar Union, Hans Christian Andersen, occupation, the welfare state and LEGO.

checkpoints.name: Vikings
checkpoints.note: Danish Vikings raided and settled England. Harald Bluetooth made Denmark Christian, and Cnut ruled a North Sea empire.

checkpoints.name: Kings of the north
checkpoints.note: Margaret united the north in the Kalmar Union. Denmark ruled Norway until 1814, and Tycho Brahe watched the stars.

checkpoints.name: Modern Denmark
checkpoints.note: A constitution came in 1849. Andersen and Kierkegaard wrote, the Danes saved their Jews in 1943, and the country built a welfare state.
